business_summary: KEC International Limited (NSE: KEC) is an Indian engineering, procurement and construction company specializing in power transmission lines and high-voltage substations, part of the RPG Group. It engineers and constructs the transmission and substation infrastructure this chain's grid-interconnect link tracks.

exposure_summary.narrative: KEC International sits on grid-interconnect (UNDISCOVERED, not the money corner), a real, sourced transmission-line and substation construction role per industry research. FY2026 statements (INR, year ended 2026-03-31) show strong 3-year revenue growth (11.1% CAGR) and a 7.5% operating margin, but negative operating cash flow this year (-INR 4.1B against INR 6.1B net income) and a WEAK Piotroski read (3/9), against a CLEAN Beneish score.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No grid-interconnect-specific revenue percentage is sourced for KEC International this run; transmission and substation construction is one segment within a broader EPC revenue base.

latest_fy.basis: Vendor-normalized fiscal-year revenue (INR) for the period ended 2026-03-31, yfinance-statements aggregation of KEC International Limited's local financial statements (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals; INFERRED, official_source false, not a filing quote).

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (233013200000.0 / 169968000000.0) ** (1/3) - 1 from the yfinance-statements INR revenue series, period ended 2023-03-31 to period ended 2026-03-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 17503900000.0 (INR) divided by revenue 233013200000.0 (INR), both for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow -4141300000.0 divided by net income 6055900000.0, both INR for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series. Negative operating cash flow against positive net income reflects a working-capital swing in an EPC order book, not a loss year.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow -4141300000.0 less capex 3286800000.0, divided by revenue 233013200000.0, all INR for the period ended 2026-03-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 49692400000.0 (total debt 53777600000.0 less cash 4085200000.0, both as of 2026-03-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 19477700000.0 (operating income 17503900000.0 plus depreciation 1973800000.0 for the period ended 2026-03-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 3 (state WEAK) computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/KEC-NS.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.058 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in data/market/KEC-NS.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 108117130000.0 (INR) divided by fiscal year 2026-03-31 revenue 233013200000.0 (INR).
